text: A services manager wants to make sure the team enters case priority consistently. Which feature should a Platform App Builder use to accomplish this?

options.text: In App Guidance
Path
Flow
Next Best Action

explanation: Path shows the Case priority (or status) values as a visual guide with key fields and Guidance for Success at each step, which standardizes how the team enters and moves priority. In-App Guidance gives prompts, Flow automates, and Next Best Action recommends — none of them structure a field's values for consistent entry.

text: Universal Containers needs to stamp the Stage_Last_Changed__c date field on the opportunity record whenever the StageName changes. How should the Platform App Builder implement this request?

options.text: A before-save record-triggered flow on Opportunity that assigns today's date to Stage_Last_Changed__c when StageName is changed
A scheduled path on an after-save record-triggered flow that updates Stage_Last_Changed__c to today's date 1 hour after the change
An approval process on Opportunity that uses Update Records to set Stage_Last_Changed__c to today's date when StageName is changed
An autolaunched flow invoked from a custom button that the user clicks after editing the StageName to update Stage_Last_Changed__c

explanation: A before-save record-triggered flow that checks ISCHANGED on StageName and assigns TODAY() to Stage_Last_Changed__c updates the same record with no extra DML, which is the fastest and most efficient design. A scheduled path delays the stamp, an approval process isn't an update mechanism, and a button relies on the user remembering to click it.

text: The DreamHouse Realty service manager asks for some improvements in case management. They want to enforce compliance so that cases are unable to be reverted to an earlier case status, and to ensure that certain fields are required when specific case criteria are met. Which solution should a Platform App Builder implement to meet these requirements?

options.text: Validation rules
Approval process
Case flow
Dependent picklist

explanation: Validation rules can compare the new status to PRIORVALUE to block moving a case backward and can make fields conditionally required based on case criteria, meeting both requirements declaratively. Approval processes, flows, and dependent picklists don't enforce save-time rules like these.

text: Universal Containers has two custom objects, Inspection__c and Building__c, that are not yet related. The maintenance team expects to log roughly three inspections for each building every year. The business has two requirements: When a building record is deleted, all of its related inspection records must be deleted as well automatically. Each inspection record must follow the same sharing and access settings as its building. How should the Platform App Builder create the relationship?

options.text: Create a required lookup relationship field on Building__c that relates it to Inspection__c
Create a master-detail relationship field on Building__c that relates it to Inspection__c
Create a required lookup relationship field on Inspection__c that relates it to Building__c
Create a master-detail relationship field on Inspection__c that relates it to Building__c

explanation: A master-detail field belongs on the child object (Inspection__c) pointing to the parent (Building__c): deleting the building cascades to its inspections, and the detail records inherit the master's sharing and ownership. A lookup doesn't cascade delete or inherit sharing, and the field can't be placed on the parent side.

text: Cloud Kicks conducts an evaluation of sales reps with a custom object that houses a scorecard. The company wants to ensure that only the sales reps, their managers, and their manager's executives can view the rep's scorecard, but also prevent the reps from being able to view the executive comment fields on their review. How should the Platform App Builder meet these requirements?

options.text: Use a Private sharing model granting record access using hierarchy; manage field access with record types and field-level security
Use a Private sharing model granting record access using custom settings; manage field access with page layouts and field-level security
Use a Private sharing model granting record access using hierarchy; manage field access with field-level security
Use a Private sharing model granting record access using custom settings; manage field access with record types and page layouts

explanation: A Private OWD with the role hierarchy grants managers and executives access to their reps' scorecards without opening them to everyone, and field-level security hides the executive comment fields from the reps' profile or permission set. Page layouts and record types don't secure fields; FLS does.

text: A sales team receives a list of approximately 800 leads each morning from the marketing team. The marketing team does not know if any of the leads are currently in the pipeline and sends the entire list each morning. Which tool should a Platform App Builder use to import these leads into Salesforce while preventing the duplicates from being inserted?

options.text: Data Import Wizard
Data Loader
Dataloader.io
Manual entry

explanation: The Data Import Wizard for Leads can match on email (or other fields) and skip or update duplicates during import, so the daily list can be loaded without inserting duplicates. Data Loader and dataloader.io insert whatever they're given unless duplicate rules block them, and manual entry doesn't scale to 800 records.

text: A company needs to evaluate all open cases related to an Account when that Account's status changes to "Critical". The flow must loop through the retrieved cases, change their priority to "High", and then update all modified records in a single database operation. Which combination of Flow elements must the company use inside the loop to store the changes before updating the database?

options.text: A Decision element and an Update Records element
An Assignment element and a Collection Filter element
An Assignment element and a collection variable
A Loop element and a Get Records element

explanation: Inside the loop you assign the new priority to the current item and add it to a record collection variable with an Assignment element; after the loop, a single Update Records element writes the whole collection. Updating inside the loop causes one DML per record and hits governor limits.

text: Cloud Kicks has three types of customer support processes: Platinum, Diamond, and Bronze. The Platform App Builder created separate record types for each process on the Case object. The customer support team should be unable to create new cases with the Bronze record type. How should the app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a permission set group for Case that includes Platinum and Diamond record types
Update the organization-wide defaults to Private for Case
Update the support team profile to remove the Bronze record type
Make the record type hidden to support users; update sharing rules to Private

explanation: Record type availability is controlled per profile (or permission set): remove the Bronze record type from the support team's profile so they can't choose it when creating cases. OWD and sharing rules control record visibility, not which record types a user can create.

text: Ursa Major Solar wants to create a relationship between the standard Contact object and a custom Solar Project object. Contacts can potentially be related to multiple Solar Project objects, and a Solar Project can have multiple Contacts associated with it. How should the Platform App Builder configure the data model?

options.text: One master-detail relationship on Contact and one master-detail relationship on Solar Project
Two lookup relationships on a new custom object
One lookup relationship on Contact and one lookup relationship on Solar Project
Two master-detail relationships on a new custom object

explanation: A many-to-many relationship is modeled with a junction object that has two master-detail relationships — one to Contact and one to Solar Project — so each junction record links one contact to one project. Lookups or master-details placed directly on the two objects can't express many-to-many.

text: A Platform App Builder notices several accounts converted from leads are missing information they expected to be caught via Account validation rules. What is the source of this issue?

options.text: Account validation rules fail to validate on records converted from a lead
The lead settings are allowing users to intentionally bypass validation rules
The lead settings are unchecked to require validation for converted leads
Lead validation rules fail to validate on records when they are being converted

explanation: By default, validation rules on Account, Contact, and Opportunity are not enforced when records are created through lead conversion. Turning on Require Validation for Converted Leads in Lead Settings makes conversion honor those rules.

text: Universal Containers uses a Private sharing model on Accounts. User A and user B both own Accounts of their own, and have been sent a link to look at a new account record owned by user C. User A is able to open and view the record, but user B receives an insufficient privileges error. User A and user B have the same role in the role hierarchy as user C. Why does user A have access, but user B does not?

options.text: User A and user B have different login access policies
User B has a scoping rule that restricts the account access
User A has View All Fields permission on the Account object
User A is in a public group that has access via a sharing rule

explanation: Under a Private OWD, users with the same role as the owner get no access through the hierarchy, so User A must be receiving access another way — most likely membership in a public group that a sharing rule grants access to. View All Fields controls fields, not records; scoping rules filter what's shown, not access; login policies are unrelated.

text: The Platform App Builder at Ursa Major Solar created a master-detail relationship between a parent object Galaxy__c and child object Star__c. What is the effect of creating this type of relationship if users want to report on Galaxy__c with Star__c?

options.text: A new custom report type will need to be created for Star__c with lookup fields from Galaxy__c
A Star__c report type with Galaxy__c as a field will be automatically created
A Galaxy__c with Star__c report type will be automatically created
A new custom report type will need to be created for Galaxy__c with Star__c

explanation: When a master-detail relationship is created, Salesforce automatically creates a standard report type of the form 'Galaxy__c with Star__c' so users can report on parent records with their child details immediately. No custom report type is needed.

text: A Platform App Builder at Northern Trail Outfitters created a sandbox template for Accounts, Projects, and Project Milestones to reconfigure some flows for the project management app. Which type of testing environment should the app builder create?

options.text: Developer Pro
Partial Copy
Scratch Org
Developer

explanation: A sandbox template (which chooses the objects to copy) is a Partial Copy sandbox feature; Partial Copy includes a sample of production data for the selected objects. Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes carry metadata only, and scratch orgs are source-driven and don't use templates.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters has two custom objects that are part of a master-detail relationship. What determines the ownership and sharing access of the detail record?

options.text: The default owner is set in the parent object's settings
The Owner field on the Master record
The owner is set independently on the detail object's settings
The Owner field on the Detail record

explanation: Detail records in a master-detail relationship don't have their own Owner field; ownership and sharing are inherited from the master record's owner. That's why the Owner field on the master determines access to the detail.

text: Managers at Universal Containers want a quick way to create additional accounts to form a hierarchy from a parent Account record. They want to auto-populate five fields based on the parent to make it easier for users to create the child accounts quickly. What should the Platform App Builder recommend?

options.text: Create a custom action
Add a custom link on Account
Customize a global quick action
Add Path on Account hierarchy

explanation: An object-specific Create a Record quick action (custom action) on Account can create a child Account with predefined field values copied from the parent record, giving managers a one-click way to build the hierarchy. A custom link can't set values on save, global actions can't reference the parent record, and Path isn't for record creation.

text: Ursa Major Solar has received complaints about inconsistent customer service experiences and wants to provide its agents with a checklist of items that must be accomplished when servicing a case. What should a Platform App Builder use to implement this?

options.text: Assistant component
Activity Timeline component
Actions & Recommendations component
Highlights Panel component

explanation: The Actions & Recommendations component displays a checklist of steps (flows, quick actions, recommendations) for the agent to complete on a record, driven by an Actions & Recommendations deployment. The Assistant, Activity Timeline, and Highlights Panel components don't provide a task checklist.

text: Cloud Kicks has 5 years of sales data and would like to track when customers made their first purchase. How should a Platform App Builder use a roll-up summary to meet the requirements?

options.text: Create a new roll-up summary field called First Order Date, using Type MIN on the Opportunity Close Date with a filter where IsWon = TRUE
Create a new roll-up summary field called First Order Date, using Type SUM on Opportunity Close Date
Create a new date field called First Order Date, then set the date using a roll-up summary on Opportunity Close Date
Create a new date field called First Order Date, then create a roll-up summary to update the field using Type MIN

explanation: A roll-up summary field on Account with type MIN over Opportunity Close Date, filtered to Won = True, returns the earliest winning close date — the customer's first purchase. SUM doesn't apply to dates, and a roll-up can't populate a separate date field.

text: The sales reps at Cloud Kicks have not been properly filling out their sales pipeline, and are regularly creating new opportunities and moving them directly to a "Contract Signed" status. How should a Platform App Builder prevent this from happening so the sales reps have better insight into the true sales pipeline?

options.text: Set up Path on the Opportunity object to guide sales users through key Opportunity stages using the standard Sales Path
Set up Guidance for Success as part of Sales Path to provide sales users with best practices to follow during each Opportunity stage
Set up a validation rule to prevent users from skipping critical steps as they progress through Opportunity stages
Set up an approval flow for managers to approve stage progression when sales users update the Opportunity stage to "Contract Signed"

explanation: A validation rule using PRIORVALUE(StageName) can block moving directly from a new opportunity to Contract Signed, forcing reps through the intermediate stages so the pipeline reflects reality. Path and Guidance for Success only guide, and an approval flow adds manager overhead without preventing the skip.

text: Universal Containers has two types of applicants: hourly and salary. There are separate record types for each. While all members of the human resources (HR) department need to be able to view all applicant records, only the hiring manager and VP of HR should be able to create Salary applicant records. What should the Platform App Builder recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Remove the Create permission for the Salary applicant object for everyone except the manager and VP
Update the organization-wide default to Private and create a sharing rule for the role of recruiting manager
Configure the hourly record type as the default and instruct non-management users to accept the default record type
Create a permission set containing the Salary record type and assign it to the appropriate users

explanation: Record type access is granted through profiles and permission sets; a permission set that includes the Salary record type, assigned only to the hiring manager and VP, lets everyone else keep read access while only those two can create Salary records. Object Create permission can't be limited to one record type, and OWD/sharing don't control record types.

text: Cloud Kicks wants customer care agents to follow a guided, multi-step form directly on the Case record page to capture a product return. The form takes the agent through verifying the order, choosing a return reason, and confirming a refund method, collecting input at each step. Which type of flow should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: Record-triggered flow
Autolaunched flow
Screen flow
Schedule-triggered flow

explanation: A screen flow provides the multi-step, user-facing form that collects input at each step; it can be placed on the Case record page as a component or launched by a quick action. Record-triggered, autolaunched, and schedule-triggered flows run without a UI.

text: Universal Containers has a Lightning record page that supports both the mobile app and desktop. A Platform App Builder has downloaded a custom Lightning component from AgentExchange, but users are unable to view the component on mobile devices. What is the issue?

options.text: The component has been developed for Desktop Pages
The component needs to be activated
The record page template is unable to support mobile devices
The record page needs to be activated

explanation: Lightning components declare which form factors they support; if the developer built the component for Desktop only, it won't render on phones even though the record page supports both. Record pages and components aren't 'activated' separately, and the template isn't the constraint here.

text: Universal Containers would like account owners to be able to quickly access a report of all of the current assets associated to their account. Account owners should access this report through the Account record page. How should the Platform App Builder accomplish this?

options.text: Dashboard with Account Filter
Dynamic URL through Custom Link
Scheduled Reports
Custom Report Type

explanation: A custom link that builds a dynamic report URL passing the Account ID as a filter parameter lets each owner open a report of that account's assets right from the record page. A dashboard or scheduled report isn't per-record, and a custom report type alone doesn't put the report on the page.

text: Universal Containers has a requirement that an email notification needs to be sent to an Account owner automatically 5 days before a related Contract's end date. Which flow type and element combination should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: Schedule-triggered flow with a Get Records element and a Send Email action
Record-triggered flow with a Send Email action, using a scheduled path
Screen flow with a Send Email action and a Date element
Autolaunched flow with a Wait element and a Send Email action

explanation: A schedule-triggered flow that runs daily, gets Contracts whose End Date is 5 days away, and sends an email to each Account owner meets the requirement. A record-triggered scheduled path only fires from a record change, screen flows need a user, and autolaunched flows with Wait elements aren't the recommended pattern for date-based reminders.

text: At AW Computing, the Candidate object has a checkbox field for Previous Experience and a number field for Years of Previous Experience. The recruiting team wants the number field to display only if the Previous Experience field is checked. Which functionality should the Platform App Builder use to meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a dependency between the Previous Experience and Years of Previous Experience fields
Use a Visualforce component on the candidate page layout to conditionally display the fields
Create two different page layouts and a process to change the layout if Previous Experience is checked
Use Dynamic Forms to display the Years of Previous Experience field if Previous Experience is checked

explanation: Dynamic Forms lets you set a component visibility filter on the Years of Previous Experience field so it appears only when Previous Experience is checked. Field dependencies work only between picklists, and Visualforce or multiple layouts are heavy solutions to a simple visibility rule.

text: A Platform App Builder wants to create a report to compare the number of support cases in each status (New, In-progress, or Closed) and by priority (Critical, High, Medium, or Low). Which solution should the app builder use for the report?

options.text: Bucket Columns
Custom Report Type
Grouping
Filters

explanation: Grouping the report by Status and then by Priority (a summary or matrix report) compares case counts across both dimensions directly. Buckets create categories, filters narrow data, and a custom report type defines the object set — none compare two groupings.

text: Universal Containers requires a standardized project management tracking system to be visible within its existing Salesforce environment. The Platform App Builder decides to browse AgentExchange to find a complete, preconfigured solution that includes custom objects, fields, and automation rules. What should the app builder install from AgentExchange to ensure automatic upgrades to the package?

options.text: Change set
Unmanaged package
Managed package
Data kit

explanation: A managed package from AppExchange is upgradeable by its publisher, so new versions can be pushed or installed without losing customizations. Unmanaged packages can't be upgraded in place, change sets move metadata between connected orgs, and data kits are for Data Cloud.

text: Universal Containers is setting up Salesforce for the first time. Management wants the sales and marketing teams to have different navigation menus in the Salesforce mobile app. Which option is available to a Platform App Builder to satisfy this requirement?

options.text: Create public groups for sales and marketing, and create mobile navigation menus for each group
Create sales and marketing apps and assign the respective profiles to each app
Create roles for sales and marketing and assign a custom homepage layout for each role
Create mobile navigation menus for both the sales and marketing profiles

explanation: Navigation in the Salesforce mobile app follows the Lightning app the user is in, so creating separate Sales and Marketing apps and assigning each to the appropriate profiles gives each team its own navigation menu. Mobile navigation can't be assigned by group or role, and home page layouts don't control navigation.

text: Universal Containers wants to collect information from a user and use that input to update a related Account record. Which combination of flow elements should the Platform App Builder use to meet this requirement?

options.text: Autolaunched flow with a Screen element and an Update Records element
Record-triggered flow with a Screen element and a Create Records element
Schedule-triggered flow with an Assignment element and a Create Records element
Screen flow with Screen elements and an Update Records element

explanation: Collecting user input requires a screen flow; its Screen elements gather the values and an Update Records element writes them to the related Account. Autolaunched, record-triggered, and schedule-triggered flows can't contain Screen elements.

text: A custom field on an account is used to track finance information about a customer. Only members of the finance team have access to this field. However, the business wants to give one customer service agent, who is assigned the Customer Service profile, Read-Only access to this field for special circumstances. What is the recommended solution to grant the customer service agent access to the field?

options.text: Update the custom field's field-level security in Setup to give the agent Read-Only access to the field
Create a permission set that allows Read-Only access to the field via field-level security and assign it to the agent
Create a new profile to allow for Read-Only access to the field via field-level security and assign it to the agent
Update the Customer Service profile already assigned to the agent to allow for Read-Only access to the field via field-level security

explanation: Field-level security is set per profile or permission set; the least-disruptive way to give one user extra field access is a permission set granting Read on the field, assigned to that agent alone. Editing the shared profile or creating a new profile affects or fragments the wider user base.

text: A Platform App Builder is tasked with adding key performance indicators (KPIs) on client pages. They want to see a summary of the number of open opportunities and the number of won opportunities for each Account. Where should the app builder go to build these new rollups?

options.text: Lightning App Builder
Account object
Lightning Object Creator
Opportunity object

explanation: Roll-up summary fields are created on the master (parent) object — Account — to count child Opportunities with filters such as IsClosed = False or IsWon = True. Lightning App Builder and Object Creator don't create roll-ups, and the field can't live on the child object.

text: Cloud Kicks models the relationship between Stores and Loyalty Members with a custom Store_Membership__c junction object that has two master-detail relationships (one to Store__c and one to Loyalty_Member__c). A regional manager has Read access to Store__c but no access to Loyalty_Member__c. The manager reports that Store_Membership__c records do not appear on the Store record page. What should the Platform App Builder do to resolve this?

options.text: Grant Read access to the Store_Membership__c object on the profile
Grant Read access to the Loyalty_Member__c object on the profile
Create a sharing rule on the Store_Membership__c object, granting the manager's role access
Create a sharing rule on the Loyalty_Member__c object, granting the manager's role access

explanation: To see junction object records, a user needs at least Read access to both master objects; the manager lacks access to Loyalty_Member__c, so the Store_Membership__c records are hidden. Junction records inherit sharing from their masters, so sharing rules on the junction won't help.

text: Where should a Platform App Builder edit an existing app to add components to the utility bar?

options.text: Lightning Record Page
App Menu
App Manager
Lightning App Builder

explanation: The utility bar is configured per Lightning app in the App Manager (edit the app, then Utility Items), where components such as Notes, History, or custom components are added. The Lightning App Builder edits pages, not the app's utility bar.

text: Universal Containers deployed an app in a large change set from a Developer sandbox to a Developer Pro sandbox used for testing. After testing, changes had to be made to several of the components in the change set. How should a Platform App Builder move the new changes to the Developer Pro sandbox?

options.text: Rename the change set, add the changes, and re-deploy
Clone the change set and re-deploy
Refresh the test sandbox and re-deploy the change set
Update the change set and re-deploy

explanation: An uploaded change set can't be edited; to move corrections you clone it, add or replace the changed components, and upload the clone. Renaming isn't possible after upload, and refreshing the target sandbox wipes test data unnecessarily.

text: AW Computing has a custom object for service plans. A service plan needs to be associated to one and only one contact. The support manager noticed if the wrong contact is associated, the reps are unable to change the contact. The Platform App Builder already confirmed the user has correct access to the field and there are no validations associated with the service plans. What is causing the issue?

options.text: The "Allow reparenting" checkbox is checked
The "Read Only" sharing option (allowing users with at least Read access to the Master record to create, edit, or delete related Detail records) is selected
The "Read/Write" sharing option (allowing users with at least Read/Write access to the Master record to create, edit, or delete related Detail records) is selected
The "Allow reparenting" checkbox is unchecked

explanation: In a master-detail relationship the parent (master) value can only be changed if Allow reparenting is enabled on the relationship field. With it unchecked, reps can't move the service plan to a different contact even with full field access.

text: A Platform App Builder has deployed a change set from a sandbox to production. There is a long delay in the deployment. What is causing the delay?

options.text: Dependent fields are included in the change set
Profiles are included in the change set
A field type change is included in the change set
Roles are included in the change set

explanation: Changing a field's data type forces Salesforce to convert existing data during deployment, which is a slow, record-by-record operation on large objects. Profiles, roles, and dependent picklists deploy as metadata and don't cause that kind of delay.

text: A Platform App Builder has created a change set and deployed a report from their development sandbox to a Partial sandbox for User Acceptance Testing (UAT). When the app builder runs the report, no data is returned. What is causing this to happen?

options.text: Reports have to be manually re-created in each environment
Report filters have to be deployed with the change set
Data is not deployed with change sets
Reports have to be deployed with Salesforce DX

explanation: Change sets move metadata only — the report definition — never records. A Partial sandbox contains only the sample data chosen in its template, so the deployed report has no matching data to return.

text: A Platform App Builder at Cloud Kicks is creating a flow approval process for travel requests. The requirement is to assign the approval to a specific user which will be determined at runtime based on other data in the flow. How must the app builder configure the approver for the approval step?

options.text: Use a Formula resource to define the approver directly in the Approver Type field
Set the Approver Type to 'User' and select a specific user from the list
Set the Approver Type to 'Resource' and select the text variable containing the username
Set the Approver Type to 'Queue' and assign the queue that contains the dynamic user

explanation: In a flow approval process, choosing Approver Type 'Resource' lets you point the approver at a flow variable that is set at runtime from other data, so the approver is determined dynamically. Selecting a fixed user or queue hard-codes the approver, and a formula can't be used directly as the approver.

text: At DreamHouse Realty (DHR), a Platform App Builder built a new Property_Inspection__c custom object that includes fields, page layouts, an Apex class, a record-triggered flow, and a Lightning record page. The custom object is built in a Developer sandbox. The app builder must move these components to DHR's production org so the field team can begin using them. Which deployment plan should the app builder use?

options.text: Refresh the production org from the Developer sandbox to bring the new components into production
Have a DHR administrator manually recreate each component in production using Setup
Upload an outbound change set from the Developer sandbox, then deploy the inbound change set in production
Create a managed package in the Developer sandbox and install it in production using the generated install URL

explanation: Sandbox and production are connected orgs, so an outbound change set from the Developer sandbox containing the object, fields, layouts, Apex class, flow, and Lightning page, deployed as an inbound change set in production, is the standard path. Sandboxes can't be pushed to production by refresh, manual recreation is error-prone, and managed packages are for distribution, not internal deployment.

text: Shipments at Cloud Kicks (CK) are created and updated by the warehouse staff in a shipping application. The information needs to be pushed into Salesforce on a regular basis. CK's Platform App Builder creates a custom object called Delivery__c to track the information. The app builder must prevent creating duplicate delivery records and update the correct existing records when migrating data from the shipping application. How should the app builder accomplish this?

options.text: Use the Import Wizard and match on the tracking number
Create a duplicate/match rule and use Data Loader
Use the Import Wizard and match on the Salesforce ID
Create a unique External ID field and use Data Loader

explanation: A unique External ID field holding the shipping system's identifier lets Data Loader upsert: existing deliveries are updated and new ones inserted without creating duplicates. The Import Wizard doesn't support custom-object matching at this scale, and duplicate rules block rather than update.

text: What is the process to upgrade an unmanaged package that is currently installed in production?

options.text: Click the update link on the Installed Packages page
Uninstall the current version and install the new version
Use the Install Wizard to install the upgrade to production
Install the new version to a Developer org then deploy to production

explanation: Unmanaged packages have no upgrade path; to get a new version you uninstall the existing package and install the new one (after preserving any customizations). Only managed packages offer in-place upgrades.

text: At DreamHouse Realty, a screen flow in production that creates a Property Visit record works correctly when the Platform App Builder runs it, but a sales rep on the "Realty Sales" profile reports that the flow errors and does not create the expected record. The app builder wants to reproduce the failure in the sales rep's permission context without involving the rep or creating production data. How should the app builder reproduce the failure?

options.text: Enable the debug log for the sales rep, ask the rep to run the flow again, and inspect the log for the failed step
Review the flow's failed interviews in Setup and inspect the variable values at the failed element
Open the flow in Flow Builder, click Debug, and select the option to run the flow as the sales rep
Request Login Access from the sales rep through Setup and run the flow while logged in as that user

explanation: Flow Builder's Debug option 'Run flow as another user' lets an admin with the right permission execute the flow in the sales rep's permission context, with debug details, without creating records or involving the rep. Failed-interview emails and Login As don't give the same controlled, data-free reproduction.

text: Ursa Major Solar wants to give sales console users an incredible experience, with the most-used components easily accessible at all times. Which solution enables reps to see and access these components from anywhere within the app without leaving the page where the team is working?

options.text: Favorites
Home page
Global actions
Utility bar

explanation: The utility bar docks components at the bottom of a Lightning app so users can open them from any page without navigating away. Favorites and the home page require leaving the current record, and global actions open a publisher rather than persistent tools.

text: Universal Containers has a record-triggered flow with a Scheduled Path to send an email 7 days after a case closes. The Platform App Builder needs to confirm that a recently closed case has an email waiting in the queue. Where in Setup should the app builder look to see this pending action?

options.text: Time-Based Automations
Flow Trigger Explorer
Apex Flex Queue
Paused and Failed Flow Interviews

explanation: Pending scheduled-path actions from record-triggered flows appear in Setup under Time-Based Automations (formerly Time-Based Workflow), where you can search for the record and see the queued action and its scheduled time. Flow Trigger Explorer shows flow ordering, not queued actions.

text: Universal Containers has a custom object called Project__c and a custom object called Time_Entry__c. A Time Entry must always be associated with a Project. However, the organization-wide default (OWD) sharing setting for Project__c is Public Read/Write, while Time_Entry__c records contain sensitive data and must be strictly Private to the user who created them. Which relationship type should the Platform App Builder use to relate Time_Entry__c to Project__c?

options.text: Lookup relationship
Hierarchical relationship
External lookup relationship
Master-detail relationship

explanation: A lookup relationship keeps Time_Entry__c as an independent object with its own OWD, so it can be Private while Project__c stays Public Read/Write; the lookup field can be marked required to guarantee a project is always set. A master-detail would force time entries to inherit the project's sharing.

text: Universal Containers (UC) requires that all users specify a contract is sent on each opportunity prior to marking it as "Closed Won". UC wants to be able to report on how many opportunities have sent contracts compared to how many have a missing contract when the opportunities closed. Which field type should a Platform App Builder configure to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Picklist
Text area
Checkbox
Text

explanation: A checkbox 'Contract Sent' gives a clean yes/no value that a validation rule can require before Closed Won and that reports can group and count. Text fields allow inconsistent entries, and a picklist adds unnecessary values for a binary fact.

text: A company wants to prevent sales users from saving Opportunity Products with discounts over 15% for opportunity records. How should the company configure this requirement?

options.text: Validation rule on the Opportunity Product record
Approval process triggered by Opportunity Product updates
Validation rule on the Opportunity record
Big Deal alert for the Opportunity record

explanation: The Discount field lives on the Opportunity Product (OpportunityLineItem), so a validation rule on that object — Discount > 0.15 — blocks the save when the discount exceeds 15%. A rule on Opportunity can't see individual line items, and approvals or Big Deal alerts don't prevent the save.

text: At Universal Containers, two record-triggered flows run after an opportunity is updated. One calculates a custom discount amount, the other sends an email notification that references the calculated discount. The Platform App Builder must guarantee that the discount calculation flow runs before the notification flow, while keeping the two flows separate for ownership reasons. How should the app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Configure the notification flow to run asynchronously after the save so it executes after other record-triggered flows on Opportunity
Add a scheduled path with a zero-minute interval at the start of the notification flow to delay its execution
Move both flows' logic into a single before-save record-triggered flow on Opportunity to control execution order natively
Set the trigger order on Flow Trigger Explorer for each flow so the discount-calculation flow has a lower trigger order value than the notification flow

explanation: Flow Trigger Explorer lets you set an explicit trigger order on record-triggered flows for the same object and event; giving the discount flow a lower order value guarantees it runs before the notification flow while keeping them separate. Async paths and zero-minute scheduled paths don't guarantee ordering.

text: A Platform App Builder needs to implement a solution where a virtual assistant can independently handle end-to-end customer service interactions — understanding intent, querying Salesforce data, and taking action — without requiring a human to intervene at each step. Which feature supports this requirement?

options.text: Case Assignment Rules
Agentforce
Experience Cloud with Live Chat
Einstein Bots

explanation: Agentforce agents use an LLM reasoning engine to understand intent, retrieve Salesforce data, and execute actions autonomously across a conversation, which is the end-to-end capability described. Einstein Bots follow scripted dialogs, and assignment rules or chat don't act independently.

text: Universal Containers implemented an application process that uses custom objects called Internships and Applications. The organization-wide default (OWD) for Internships has been set to Private and is the master in the master-detail relationship with Applications. The VP of human resources wants to allow Edit access to Applications to recruiters. How should a Platform App Builder configure the proper access?

options.text: Add a sharing rule that grants the users Read/Write access to Internship records
Create a queue for the web applications and assign access to users who will edit the records
Set the OWD on the Applications object to Read/Write
Create a sharing rule that grants the users Read/Write access to Application records

explanation: Applications is the detail in a master-detail relationship, so its sharing is inherited from Internships; granting recruiters Read/Write on Internship records through a sharing rule gives them edit access to the related Applications. A detail object has no independent OWD, and queues don't grant edit access.

text: Universal Containers assigns system access via permission sets and permission set groups to ensure each user has proper access. One department with varying levels of support staff has five consistent permission sets they require in order to complete their duties. Some higher-level staff have additional permission sets that are only required for them. How should a Platform App Builder recommend assigning permission sets to users?

options.text: Utilize the Manage Assignments button to assign each user with the same set of permission set groups and permission sets
Utilize the Data Loader to mass update the desired users with their full list of permission sets and permission set groups
Utilize the Manage Assignments button to assign a permission set group and additional individual permission sets to each user
Utilize the Data Import Wizard to mass update the desired users with their full list of permission sets and permission set groups

explanation: Bundle the five common permission sets into a permission set group assigned to everyone in the department, then assign the extra permission sets individually to the senior staff — all through Manage Assignments. Assigning everyone the same full list over-grants, and the Import Wizard can't assign permissions.

text: A Platform App Builder needs to display different icons and control the text color based on a formula field. How should the app builder achieve this task?

options.text: Modify the formula to use IMAGE() and CASE()
Add the formula field to the page layout, and set field help with icon and color cues
Create a screen flow and add it as a component on the page
Use Dynamic Forms Conditional Formatting

explanation: A formula field can return IMAGE() for icons and wrap text in colored output using CASE() to choose the icon or color per value, all declaratively. Field help text and screen flows don't change display, and conditional formatting isn't a Dynamic Forms feature.

text: A Platform App Builder is asked to create a sandbox for a developer. The developer will be testing robust sample data sets and will need to store up to 250 MB of data. The sandbox will be refreshed each day. Which type of sandbox should the app builder create?

options.text: Full
Developer
Partial Copy
Developer Pro

explanation: A Developer Pro sandbox holds up to 1 GB of data and can be refreshed daily, which covers the 250 MB of test data. Developer sandboxes cap at 200 MB, and Partial Copy and Full sandboxes have longer refresh intervals.

text: A Platform App Builder built a flow that retrieves all the opportunities related to a specific Account. The app builder wants to filter only the top five highest value opportunities based on the amount. Which element should the app builder use to achieve the requirements?

options.text: Collection Sort
Decision
Collection Filter
Transform

explanation: Collection Sort orders the retrieved opportunities by Amount descending and has a 'limit number of items' option, so keeping the top five is a single element. Collection Filter narrows by criteria but doesn't rank, and Decision or Transform don't sort.

text: Universal Containers wants to improve the process to create opportunity records related to an Account. Many fields can be populated based on the Account record. Some fields require input from the user. What should a Platform App Builder configure to meet the requirement?

options.text: Quick action on the Account object
Assignment rule triggered from Account update
Quick action on the Opportunity object
Assignment rule triggered from Opportunity update

explanation: A Create a Record quick action on the Account object (creating an Opportunity) can predefine field values from the parent Account and still present the remaining fields for user input. Assignment rules don't create records, and an Opportunity-side action can't pull the parent context.

text: Universal Containers manages internal projects by department using a custom object called Projects. Only employees in the project's respective department should have view access to all of the department's project records. If an employee changes job roles and moves to another department, the employee should no longer have access to the projects within their former department. Which option meets these requirements, assuming the organization-wide default for Projects is set to Private?

options.text: Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users by Public Groups
Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users by Permission Sets
Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users by Profiles
Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users by Account Teams

explanation: A criteria-based sharing rule on Project department can share with public groups; when an employee's department changes, moving them between groups removes their old access automatically. Sharing rules can't target permission sets or profiles directly, and account teams aren't relevant to a custom object.

text: The Platform App Builder at Northern Trail Outfitters created a report type for opportunities with or without shipments. The operations team wants to see the account rating information on the report. What should the app builder do to fulfill this request?

options.text: Change the account/opportunity relationship to a master-detail relationship
Add the Account Rating field to the Opportunity record page
Use "Add fields related via lookup" with the view set to opportunities
Change the primary object of the custom report type to the Account object

explanation: In the custom report type's field layout, 'Add fields related via lookup' lets you pull Account fields (such as Rating) through the Opportunity's Account lookup into the opportunity view of the report. Changing the relationship type or the primary object is unnecessary and disruptive.

text: Universal Containers needs the 18-digit record ID from opportunity records when exporting data to Excel in order to ensure each record is treated uniquely. Which formula should a Platform App Builder use to create this new field?

options.text: ISNUMBER(Id)
CASESAFEID(Id)
TEXT(Id)
VALUE(Id)

explanation: CASESAFEID(Id) converts the 15-character case-sensitive ID into the 18-character case-insensitive form, which is what Excel and other case-insensitive tools need to treat records uniquely. TEXT, VALUE, and ISNUMBER don't produce the 18-digit form.

text: A production org includes custom objects containing confidential information. A sandbox is needed that includes data records, excludes all of the confidential objects, and can be refreshed weekly. Which steps should a Platform App Builder take to meet these requirements?

options.text: Create a Developer sandbox and schedule Data Loader to download selected object data weekly
Create a Full Copy sandbox and use a sandbox template
Create a Developer Pro sandbox and schedule Data Loader to download selected object data weekly
Create a Partial Copy sandbox and use a sandbox template

explanation: A Partial Copy sandbox uses a sandbox template to choose which objects (and their sample data) are copied, so the confidential objects can be excluded, and it can be refreshed every 5 days. Full sandboxes refresh only every 29 days, and Developer sandboxes carry no data.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to set up a custom child object to track gift cards issued to a customer. A key requirement is to track the total number of gift cards opened and gift cards issued on an Account. CK wants to permanently ensure the gift cards are unable to be moved across any other Account once created. Which field type should a Platform App Builder create on the gift card object to support this requirement?

options.text: Master-detail relationship
Roll-up summary
Lookup relationship
Formula

explanation: A master-detail relationship to Account makes gift cards true children: roll-up summary fields on Account can count them, and unless Allow reparenting is enabled, a gift card can never be moved to another account. A lookup allows reparenting and doesn't support roll-ups.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) has a formula field Specialty__c on Opportunity that gets its value from the Specialty__c field on the related Account. CK has changed its processes to allow opportunities to have different values for Specialty__c than their Account. Sales reps need to be able to enter values for the Specialty__c field on Opportunity, while preserving the values on existing opportunities. What should a Platform App Builder do to achieve this?

options.text: Export the data, convert the field to a text field, and import the data
Create a new text field and import the formula field values in it
Create a new text field and keep using the existing formula field
Convert the field to a text field and the values will be in it

explanation: Formula fields can't be converted to another data type. Create a new text field, load the current formula values into it with Data Loader so existing opportunities keep their specialty, then reps can edit the text field going forward (and the formula can be retired).

text: Universal Containers needs an automation that runs every Sunday at 2:00 a.m. The automation sets a custom checkbox field, Inactive__c, to True on every account whose standard Last Activity Date is more than 90 days in the past. The automation must evaluate all account records, and it must repeat on this schedule every week. Which flow design should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A record-triggered flow on Account with a scheduled path set to run 90 days after each Account's Last Activity Date
An autolaunched flow that an app builder schedules to run every Sunday at 2:00 a.m.
A schedule-triggered flow on Account, set to a Weekly frequency with a Sunday 2:00 a.m. start time, with entry conditions selecting Accounts whose Last Activity Date is more than 90 days old
A schedule-triggered flow on Account, set to a Once frequency for the upcoming Sunday at 2:00 a.m., with entry conditions selecting Accounts whose Last Activity Date is more than 90 days old

explanation: A schedule-triggered flow runs at a set time on a recurring frequency; set it to Weekly on Sunday at 2:00 a.m., choose Account as the object, and use entry conditions for Last Activity Date more than 90 days ago so every matching account is processed. A 'Once' schedule wouldn't repeat, and a record-triggered scheduled path fires per record change rather than as a sweep.

text: Cloud Kicks wants a visual representation to track delivery status. Which component should a Platform App Builder recommend?

options.text: Related list
Path
Details
Related record

explanation: Path renders picklist values as a visual progress bar, so a Delivery Status picklist becomes a clear visual tracker on the record page. Related lists, details, and related record components don't visualize stage progress.

text: Universal Containers wants to build a screen that gives the user the ability to edit all order line items related to a specific order. The user should also be able to add new order line items. Which screen component should the Platform App Builder use to achieve the requirements?

options.text: Section
Repeater
Data Table
Slider

explanation: The Repeater screen component lets a user add multiple sets of the same fields on one screen — here, several order line items — and add new instances as needed, then the collected values are used to create or update records. Data Table displays records but doesn't capture new rows, and Section and Slider are layout/input widgets.

text: Universal Containers is excited to launch a new app. The company wants to increase the adoption rate and guide users through different walkthroughs and targeted prompts. What should the Platform App Builder recommend?

options.text: Build a screen flow
Use In-App Guidance
Use Dynamic Actions
Upgrade to Dynamic Forms

explanation: In-App Guidance delivers prompts and multi-step walkthroughs targeted to specific apps, pages, and user profiles, which is designed for driving adoption of a new app. Flows, dynamic actions, and Dynamic Forms change functionality rather than coach users.

text: Universal Containers uses a custom picklist called Account_Region__c on the Account object. The VP of sales has asked that the value of this field be visible on opportunities. What should a Platform App Builder use to create this solution?

options.text: Cross-object formula field
Field history tracking
Lookup field
Field-level security

explanation: A cross-object formula field on Opportunity referencing TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c) displays the account's region on every related opportunity and stays current automatically. Field history, a lookup, or FLS don't surface a parent value.

text: Universal Containers has a defined need to add the contents of a white paper of its product offerings within a field on the Product object. This content contains tables, lists, and images. Which field format should a Platform App Builder use to ensure the appropriate display?

options.text: Text Area
Text Area (Long)
Text Area (Rich)
Text Area (Encrypted)

explanation: Text Area (Rich) supports formatted content — tables, bulleted lists, and embedded images — which the other text area types can't render. Long text areas store plain text only, and the encrypted type is for sensitive short values.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to track orders against inventory, ensuring its ability to fulfill order requests. CK created a junction object called Request Inventory to enable many-to-many relationships with the Inventory and Order objects. What does the Platform App Builder need to provide to ensure users can view Request Inventory records?

options.text: Read access to both master objects
Sharing rules on the Request Inventory object
Read access to the first master object
Apex-based sharing on the first master object

explanation: Junction object records are visible only to users who have at least Read access to both master records, because the junction inherits sharing from both parents. Sharing rules and Apex sharing don't apply to a master-detail junction.

text: Universal Containers (UC) uses a custom picklist field called Account Region on the Account record. UC wants this region to be reflected on all related contact records and stay in sync if the value of this field changes on the Account. Which solution should the Platform App Builder implement?

options.text: Create a picklist field called 'Account Region' on the Contact object. Create a Lookup Relationship to update this field if the Account Region field on the Account is changed
Create a formula field on the Contact object. Set the value of the formula to TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c)
Create a formula field on the Contact object. Set the value of the formula to ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Region__c)
Create a text field called 'Account Region' on the Contact object

explanation: A formula field on Contact using TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c) shows the picklist value from the parent Account and updates automatically whenever the account changes, with no data to keep in sync. Separate picklist or text fields would drift out of sync, and ISPICKVAL returns a boolean rather than the value.

text: Ursa Major Solar is ramping up the sales team to meet increased demand. As part of the short ramp-up for these new reps, the manager wants to provide a help guide so reps can easily get help where needed during the different sales processes. Which solution should a Platform App Builder recommend?

options.text: Path
Journey Builder
Flow
Chatter Publisher

explanation: Path with Guidance for Success lets you attach help text, tips, and links to each stage so new reps get contextual guidance as they move through the sales process. Flow and Chatter don't provide stage-based help, and Journey Builder is a Marketing Cloud tool.

text: Cloud Kicks is building a Field Generation prompt template in Prompt Builder that populates a custom field on the Contact record page with a paragraph summarizing the contact's most recent orders. To ground the prompt in the contact's related order data, the Platform App Builder needs to build a flow. Which type of flow should the app builder use?

options.text: Template-triggered prompt flow
Record-triggered flow
Schedule-triggered flow
Autolaunched flow

explanation: A Template-Triggered Prompt Flow is the flow type built to ground prompt templates: it receives the record as input, queries related data (the contact's orders), and passes the result back to the template with Add Prompt Instructions. Other flow types can't be selected as a prompt template resource.

text: Cloud Kicks created a Locked__c custom field to identify account records that should restrict modifications for all users except the system administrator. Which validation rule enforces this requirement on locked account records?

options.text: AND(Locked__c = TRUE, $UserRole.Name != "System Administrator")
AND(Locked__c = TRUE, $Profile.Name != "System Administrator")
AND(Locked__c = TRUE, Stage = "Closed Won", $UserRole.Name != "System Administrator")
AND(Locked__c = TRUE, $Profile.Name = "System Administrator")

explanation: The rule should fire when the record is locked and the current user's profile isn't System Administrator: AND(Locked__c = TRUE, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator'). $UserRole checks roles rather than the admin profile, and Option D would block only administrators.

text: A Platform App Builder created multiple custom fields, page layouts, and reports in the sandbox and added them to a change set. After the change set was deployed to production, the custom fields were not displayed on the page layouts. What should the app builder do?

options.text: Update page layout assignments
Redeploy the change set
Update field-level security in production
Recreate the fields in production

explanation: Exam key: page layouts deployed by a change set arrive in production but their assignments to profiles and record types are not carried over, so the updated layouts (with the new fields) aren't the ones users see until the assignments are updated. Note: if the layouts are assigned correctly and fields are still missing, check field-level security — change sets deploy FLS only when profiles are included.
reviewNote: Key taken from the simulator file; worth a second look — see explanation.

text: Universal Containers (UC) wants to implement an email alert to the case owner after deleting a case's related tasks. How should UC meet this requirement?

options.text: Configure an assignment rule
Set up an escalation rule
Build a record-triggered flow to run after the task got deleted
Build an After Delete Apex trigger

explanation: Record-triggered flows can be configured to run when a record is deleted; a flow on Task with the 'A record is deleted' trigger can look up the parent case and send an email alert to its owner, with no code. Assignment and escalation rules don't respond to deletions.

text: Universal Containers' 24/7 support requires a guided wizard to step customer service reps through a standardized troubleshooting script. The process must capture user input at various stages and create a follow-up case record upon completion. Which type of flow should the Platform App Builder build to provide this interactive user interface?

options.text: Screen flow
Schedule-triggered flow
Record-triggered flow
Platform event-triggered flow

explanation: A screen flow presents the guided troubleshooting script step by step, captures the rep's input at each screen, and can create the follow-up case at the end. The other flow types run in the background without a user interface.

text: A service coordinator (SC) for Ursa Major Solar does a final review of work orders owned by a technician for a specific region before the records are submitted for an invoice. Before closing out the work order, the SC needs to modify data or remove attachments that were added by mistake. The SC also needs access to any other related records owned by the technician. Which solution provides the required access, given a private data model?

options.text: Create an SC sharing rule and a corresponding public group
Create an assignment rule that updates records owned by technicians in that region with the SC
Change work order access on the SC's profile to Modify All
Give the SC a permission set with the Modify All Data system permission

explanation: A sharing rule that shares work orders owned by technicians in the region with a public group containing the service coordinator, at Read/Write, gives the SC edit access (including attachments) and can be extended to the related objects — without granting org-wide Modify All. Assignment rules don't exist for work orders, and Modify All grants far more than needed.

text: The human resources department at Cloud Kicks (CK) uses a custom object JobApplication__c to record all job applicant information they receive, which includes fields for the applicant's current and desired salaries. Any CK user who performs hiring manager functions needs to be able to see all applicants' salary information. Which tool should the Platform App Builder use to accomplish this?

options.text: Sharing Rules
Permission Sets
Page Layouts
Organization-Wide Defaults

explanation: Access to the salary fields is field-level security; a permission set granting Read on those fields, assigned to whoever performs hiring manager duties, gives exactly the right users visibility regardless of profile. Sharing rules and OWD control records, and page layouts don't secure fields.

text: Sales reps at Universal Containers use Salesforce on their mobile devices. They want a way to add new contacts quickly and then follow up later to complete the additional information necessary. Which mobile solution should a Platform App Builder recommend to create the new contact?

options.text: Use Path and set predefined values
Build a global action to create Contacts
Add a compact layout to Contacts
Customize the mobile menu to move Contacts to the top

explanation: A global Create a Record action for Contact appears in the mobile app's action bar, so reps can capture a few required fields on the spot and complete the record later. Compact layouts control display, Path isn't for creation, and reordering the menu doesn't speed entry.

text: A Platform App Builder is working with a client to format shipping ZIP codes. The client has been struggling with data inconsistency amongst their users and only wants 5-digit variations saved. How should the app builder ensure that the client's shipping ZIP code is formatted properly?

options.text: Create a screen flow to enter address information and populate the ZIP code in the desired format
Create a validation rule to enforce proper formatting and block any ZIP codes that are not 5-digit
Create a custom ZIP code field with help text displaying the desired data input formatting as XXXXX
Create an approval process for manager sign off on all shipping codes entered by users

explanation: A validation rule using REGEX (for example REGEX(ShippingPostalCode, '\\d{5}')) rejects any value that isn't exactly five digits, enforcing consistency at save time. Help text and screen flows don't prevent bad values, and approvals are the wrong tool for format checks.

text: Universal Containers uses a custom object called Projects. When managers assign projects, they set a custom field on the Project record called Estimated Hours. Once set, users should be able to decrease but not increase the value. How should a Platform App Builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a validation rule that uses the ISCHANGED function
Create a formula field that uses the PREVGROUPVAL function
Create a formula default value for the custom field
Create a validation rule that uses the PRIORVALUE function

explanation: A validation rule comparing Estimated_Hours__c to PRIORVALUE(Estimated_Hours__c) can block any save where the new value is greater than the previous one while still allowing decreases. ISCHANGED only detects a change, not its direction, and formulas can't prevent edits.

text: Universal Containers wants to control the visibility for a specific section of a Lightning page based on the device type used by the User. What should a Platform App Builder recommend?

options.text: Configure different Record Types
Create a Lightning web component
Edit the Page Layout
Use Dynamic Forms

explanation: Dynamic Forms field sections support component visibility rules, including the Form Factor of the device, so a section can be shown on desktop and hidden on phone (or vice versa). Page layouts and record types don't vary by device, and an LWC is unnecessary.

text: Universal Containers wants to match Opportunity data from Salesforce to the records in a financial database. What is required to configure an indirect lookup relationship in Salesforce between the Salesforce Opportunity records and those in a financial database?

options.text: TEXT(Id)
CASESAFE(Id)
External ID
Salesforce Record ID

explanation: An indirect lookup relationship links an external object to a standard or custom object by matching a unique External ID field on the Salesforce object against a field in the external system. The Salesforce record ID isn't usable because the external system doesn't store it.

text: A Platform App Builder created a change set for new fields and updated page layouts in their sandbox. After deploying the change set to production, the page layout appears to be missing three fields that were previously showing on the production layout. What is causing this to happen?

options.text: The validation failed and the deployment was rolled back
The newly-deployed page layout overwrote the existing one in production when deployed
The permissions to the fields were not included in the change set and therefore removed
The page layout assignment needs to be updated after deployment

explanation: A page layout in a change set is deployed as a whole and replaces the existing production layout, so any fields that were on the production layout but not on the sandbox version disappear. Failed validations roll back completely, and missing FLS would hide fields on every layout rather than remove them from one.

text: After discovering a second sun in the solar system, Ursa Major Solar wants to change the field relationship between Sun__c and Planet__c to a lookup rather than a master-detail. What should a Platform App Builder consider about the effect on reporting before making this change?

options.text: Existing reports created under the Sun__c with Planet__c report type made by Salesforce will be deleted
Existing roll-up summary fields will remain on the Sun__c object and available for reporting, but will no longer update
Existing roll-up summary fields will be deleted from the Sun__c object and from any reports where they were added
Existing reports created under the Sun__c with Planet__c report type made by Salesforce might be unusable, but not deleted

explanation: Converting master-detail to lookup deletes the roll-up summary fields (they can't exist on a lookup), and the auto-generated 'Sun__c with Planet__c' report type is removed — reports built on it may become unusable but are not deleted. Roll-ups are not retained as static fields.

text: Which Lightning component for related lists should a Platform App Builder use to enable record sort order and hiding actions?

options.text: Related Lists
Related List - Single
Related List Quick Links
Dynamic Related List - Single

explanation: The Dynamic Related List – Single component lets you configure the related list's fields, filters, sort order, and which quick actions appear, all on the Lightning page. The standard Related List components take their configuration from the page layout and don't allow sorting or hiding actions.

text: A sales manager at Cloud Kicks wants the team to spend more time in the field and less time manually entering the information found on the business cards they collect. What should the Platform App Builder do to help achieve this goal without sacrificing data quality?

options.text: Configure a global action to auto-populate key fields for the user
Create a data entry wizard using Flow to automate data entry
Use a formula field to populate key fields for the sales user
Evaluate data enrichment products on the AgentExchange to automate data entry

explanation: Data enrichment products on AppExchange (business-card scanners, contact data services) capture and populate contact data automatically with validated values, cutting manual entry without sacrificing quality. Global actions, flows, and formulas still require the rep to type the information.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to simultaneously delete a Supplier__c record and all Supplier_Item__c records if a partnership ends with a supplier. Which solution should a Platform App Builder use to meet the requirement?

options.text: Master-detail
Indirect lookup
Hierarchical
Many-to-many

explanation: A master-detail relationship cascades deletes: deleting the Supplier__c master automatically deletes all of its Supplier_Item__c details. Lookups (indirect or standard), hierarchical relationships, and junctions don't cascade the delete.

text: At Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO), a Platform App Builder built a new commission calculation flow and supporting components in a Developer sandbox. Before the change reaches production, the project lead requires sales operations users to validate the calculation against real Opportunity data. NTO has a Full sandbox available. Which deployment plan should the app builder use?

options.text: Deploy the components from the Developer sandbox to production using a change set with the Validate Only option, then conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) in production
Refresh the Developer sandbox from production to bring in real Opportunity data, conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) in the Developer sandbox, then deploy to production
Deploy the components from the Developer sandbox directly to production, then have sales operations users validate in production
Deploy the components from the Developer sandbox to the Full sandbox, conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) in the Full sandbox, then deploy to production

explanation: Deploy the components to the Full sandbox — which contains a complete copy of production data — so sales operations can run UAT against real Opportunity data, then promote to production after sign-off. Testing in production or in a Developer sandbox (no data) doesn't meet the requirement, and Validate Only doesn't make components usable.

text: Universal Containers' global support team routes complex milestone approvals based on the region of the submitting user. They need the flow to dynamically assign the approval task to a specific regional queue instead of a statically hard-coded user ID. How should the Platform App Builder store and reference the queue assignments inside the Flow Builder logic?

options.text: Hard code individual user profile IDs into a Screen element, then use a Get Records element
Use a formula variable that evaluates the queue's DeveloperName, then use a Get Records element
Launch an asynchronous path that ignores the record owner field
Map the approval request to a custom text field on the Task object

explanation: Store the regional queue's DeveloperName in a formula (or text) variable derived from the user's region, then use Get Records on Group to retrieve the queue's ID and assign the approval to it dynamically. Hard-coding user IDs breaks when people change, and the other options don't route to a queue.

text: DreamHouse Realty wants to make sure an Opportunity has a field, Expected_Close_Date__c, populated before it is allowed to enter the qualified stage. What should a Platform App Builder use to efficiently meet this requirement?

options.text: Page layout
Validation rule
Lookup auto-completion
Record-triggered flow

explanation: A validation rule that requires Expected_Close_Date__c to be populated when StageName equals the qualified stage blocks the save until the field is filled, which is the simplest declarative enforcement. Page layouts can't make a field conditionally required, and a flow is heavier for a save-time check.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) needs to capture the tier for each Loyalty_Member__c record. CK has three fixed tier values: Standard, Plus, and Elite. The team wants to prevent users from entering inconsistent values and wants to filter and group Loyalty Member reports by Tier. Which field type should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A picklist field with the three values defined
A multi-select picklist field with the three values defined
A text field with no formatting constraints
A formula field that only allows three values

explanation: A single-select picklist with the three defined values enforces consistency, works in report filters and groupings, and prevents free-text variations. Multi-select allows multiple tiers, text allows anything, and formulas can't be entered by users.

text: A Platform App Builder is asked to make a custom, standalone Lightning component accessible to sales reps. The component should be accessed directly from the navigation bar of the custom "Sales Operations" Lightning App. What is the best approach to achieve this?

options.text: Add the Lightning component to the Utility Bar of the Lightning App
Embed the Lightning component into a dashboard and add the dashboard to the navigation menu
Create a Web Tab and point the URL to the Lightning component's generated endpoint
Create a Lightning Component tab and add that tab to the Lightning App's navigation menu

explanation: Expose the component as a Lightning Component tab, then add the tab to the Sales Operations app's navigation items so reps open it straight from the navigation bar. The utility bar docks tools rather than full pages, and web tabs/dashboards are workarounds.

text: Universal Containers uses the Asset object to track products that are installed at customer locations. A new object, Asset Inventory, has been created to capture details about the asset. Which approach should the Platform App Builder take to show Asset Inventory as a related list on Asset?

options.text: Create a lookup relationship on Asset Inventory to Asset. Add the Asset Inventory related list to the Asset page layout
Create a master-detail relationship on Asset to Asset Inventory. Add the Asset Inventory related list to the Asset page layout
Create a junction object to relate Asset Inventory and Asset. Add the Asset Inventory related list to the Asset page layout
Create a roll-up on Asset. Add the Asset Inventory related list to the Asset page layout

explanation: A lookup relationship field on Asset Inventory pointing to Asset makes Asset Inventory a child, so its related list can be added to the Asset page layout. Relationship fields are created on the child object, and a junction or roll-up isn't needed for a simple one-to-many.

text: A Platform App Builder wants to create a custom Sync button on Account that will call a Lightning web component that connects with an external system. This action should only be available if the custom Status field is set to Ready to Sync. What should the app builder use to add this functionality to an Account record page?

options.text: Custom link
AgentExchange product
Formula field
Dynamic action

explanation: Dynamic actions on the Lightning record page let you add the Sync action (which invokes the LWC) and set a visibility filter so it appears only when Status = Ready to Sync. Custom links and formula fields can't launch an LWC conditionally.

text: After utilizing the Lightning Object Creator to create a new object, its fields, and to insert all of the data, a Platform App Builder now needs to set up the Lightning record page. Which component should the app builder have on their Lightning record page to see all of the fields from the page layout?

options.text: Path
Recommendations
Record Detail
Highlights Panel

explanation: The Record Detail component renders all fields from the assigned page layout on a Lightning record page, which is what's needed right after creating an object with Lightning Object Creator. Path, Recommendations, and the Highlights Panel show only selected information.

text: Universal Containers wants to create a report to show job applications with or without resumes. Which consideration should the Platform App Builder be aware of when creating the custom report type?

options.text: When a custom or external object is deleted, the report type and reports remain but cause an error when the report is run
A primary object selection is locked once the custom report type has been saved
Once the report type has been deployed, it is unable to be deleted
An app builder is unable to create custom report types for objects they do not have permissions for

explanation: Once a custom report type is saved, its primary object can't be changed; if the wrong primary object was chosen you must create a new report type. Deleting the underlying object removes the report type and reports, report types can be deleted, and permissions aren't a barrier to creating them.
