text: Universal Containers (UC) has created a picklist field called Country on three separate custom objects. UC has a requirement to maintain a consistent list of values for this field on each object. Which feature should a Platform App Builder use?

options.text: State and Country Picklist
Next Best Action
Field Update
Global Picklist Value Set

explanation: A Global Picklist Value Set defines the Country values once and is shared by picklist fields on all three objects, so the list stays consistent and is maintained in one place. State and Country picklists apply only to standard address fields.

text: Universal Containers wants to send a reminder email 7 days after a Project__c record's Status field changes to On Hold. For example, a project placed on hold on March 1 should trigger its reminder on March 8, independent of any other project. Which flow design should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A platform event-triggered flow that sends the reminder email 7 days after a platform event message is received
A schedule-triggered flow on Project__c that runs once each day and sends a reminder email to each record that has been in On Hold status for 7 days
An after-save record-triggered flow on Project__c, triggered when Status is changed to On Hold, with a scheduled path set to run 7 days after the record is updated
An after-save record-triggered flow on Project__c, triggered when Status is changed to On Hold, with a scheduled path set to run 7 days after the record's CreatedDate

explanation: An after-save record-triggered flow that fires when Status changes to On Hold, with a scheduled path set to 7 days after the record is updated, sends each project's reminder relative to its own hold date. Basing the path on CreatedDate gives the wrong date, and a daily scheduled sweep is less precise and heavier.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to efficiently increase the company's adoption of Salesforce while simultaneously moving away from its reliance on spreadsheets. A Platform App Builder is given a spreadsheet everyone is sharing that needs to be added to Salesforce. The object with fields needs to be created and the data inserted simultaneously. Which tool should the app builder use?

options.text: Schema Builder
Data Loader
Lightning Object Creator
Import Wizard

explanation: Lightning Object Creator creates a custom object and its fields directly from a spreadsheet and loads the rows as records in one step. Schema Builder creates objects without data, and Data Loader or the Import Wizard load data only into an existing object.

text: Universal Containers (UC) is launching a new HR Recruitment app and needs to perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) before deploying to production. This app deals with sensitive data, testing requires realistic data volume, and needs to be tested by actual UC users. Which sandbox should a Platform App Builder recommend for this phase?

options.text: Partial Copy sandbox
Developer sandbox
Scratch Org
Developer Pro sandbox

explanation: A Partial Copy sandbox provides a realistic sample of production data (via a template) for real users to run UAT, while keeping sensitive data in a controlled sandbox. Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes have no production data, and scratch orgs are for source-driven development.

text: Universal Containers has Public Read/Write as the Account organization-wide default (OWD) setting. Visitors to the customer community site report that they can see all of the company's account records. How should a Platform App Builder configure Account sharing so that community users only see their own Account?

options.text: Define a permission set for external accounts
Set the account external OWD to Private
Create an account record type for external accounts
Define an owner-based sharing rule for external accounts

explanation: External organization-wide defaults control what community (external) users can see; setting the Account external OWD to Private restricts site visitors to their own account while internal users keep Public Read/Write. Record types and permission sets don't govern record visibility, and an owner-based rule can't work without restricting the default first.

text: When a Case at Universal Containers is escalated, three things must happen automatically: A follow-up Task is created. An Event is created on the support manager's calendar. A Custom Notification is sent to the case team. Which Flow design should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A before-save record-triggered flow on Case that uses Create Records elements for the Task and Event and a Send Custom Notification action
An after-save record-triggered flow on Case that uses Create Records elements for the Task and Event and a Send Custom Notification action
A screen flow that the support agent launches manually from the Case page when a Case is escalated
A platform event-triggered flow that listens on the Case object for the escalation

explanation: Creating a Task and an Event and sending a custom notification are all actions that need the saved Case ID, so an after-save record-triggered flow on Case with the escalation as entry criteria is the right design. Before-save flows can only update the triggering record, screen flows need a user, and Case escalation isn't a platform event.

text: A Platform App Builder wants to see the total sales for each Account. Sales are tracked as Closed Won opportunities. How should the app builder meet this need?

options.text: Create a roll-up summary field for the Opportunity object with COUNT rollup type summarizing Accounts
Create a roll-up summary field for the Account object with SUM rollup type summarizing Opportunities aggregated by Amount with filter criteria on Stage
Create a roll-up summary field for the Account object with SUM rollup type summarizing Opportunities aggregated by Amount including all records in the calculation
Create a roll-up summary field for the Account object with COUNT rollup type summarizing Opportunities

explanation: A roll-up summary on Account with type SUM over Opportunity Amount, filtered to Stage = Closed Won, totals the actual sales for each account. Including all opportunities would count open deals, and COUNT gives a number of records rather than revenue.

text: Cloud Kicks is redefining its entire business process to convert the Manager Notes field from a long text area field. The goal is to encourage managers to be more concise in their comments and stay at 255 characters or less. There is preexisting information in the Manager Notes field that often is well beyond the character limit. What happens to any existing information if the Platform App Builder tries to convert a preexisting long text area field to text area?

options.text: Preexisting information will truncate to the first 255 characters
Preexisting information will cause an error message to pop up
Preexisting information in the field will be completely lost

explanation: Changing a Long Text Area to Text Area truncates existing values to 255 characters — data beyond the limit is lost silently, so it should be exported first. The conversion doesn't fail with an error or wipe the field completely.

text: A Platform App Builder created a scheduled flow that runs at midnight to perform data cleanup. The flow is designed to query all open opportunities that haven't been worked for more than 60 days and update the Status field to Closed Lost. However, the app builder notices that the flow is running into governor limits during execution. What is the reason for this?

options.text: The app builder did not specify an object and filter criteria in the Start element of the schedule-triggered flow
The app builder did not create a Fault Path on the Update Record element
The flow contains a Loop element that contains an Update Record element inside it
Schedule-triggered flows do not support updates to standard objects like Opportunities

explanation: An Update Records element inside a Loop performs a DML operation for every iteration, which quickly exceeds governor limits on large data sets. Assign the changes inside the loop, collect the records, and update the collection once after the loop.

text: Universal Containers has changes that need to be deployed from a sandbox to production. The connection between the environments has already been established. Where should a Platform App Builder look to verify that a change set can be deployed?

options.text: Inbound Change Sets
Deployment Settings
Deployment Status
Outbound Change Sets

explanation: Change sets uploaded from a sandbox appear in the target org under Inbound Change Sets, where they can be validated and deployed. Deployment Settings manages connections, Outbound Change Sets is where they're built, and Deployment Status shows history.

text: At Universal Containers, a Platform App Builder is building a record-triggered flow on Opportunity. When a new opportunity is created, the flow must set the Stage field to a default value based on the related Account's Industry. The app builder wants the most efficient configuration. Which flow configuration should the app builder use?

options.text: An after-save, record-triggered flow with an Assignment element that sets Record.Stage based on Record.Account.Industry
A before-save, record-triggered flow with an Assignment element that sets Record.Stage based on Record.Account.Industry
An after-save, record-triggered flow with an Update Records element that sets the Opportunity's stage based on the Account's Industry
A before-save, record-triggered flow with an Update Records element that sets the Opportunity's stage based on the Account's Industry

explanation: A before-save record-triggered flow with an Assignment element sets $Record.StageName based on the related account's Industry as the opportunity is saved, with no additional DML — the most efficient design. After-save flows or Update Records elements add a second save.

text: Universal Containers wants to track installation information once a container has been purchased on a custom object. Sales reps should have visibility of all the installations associated with their opportunities. Which kind of relationship should this new object have to Opportunity?

options.text: Lookup
Many to Many
Master-Detail
Hierarchical

explanation: A lookup relationship to Opportunity lets installation records exist independently while still appearing as a related list, and because sales reps see their opportunities, sharing on the installation object can be configured to follow ownership. A master-detail would delete installations with the opportunity and isn't required here.

text: At Ursa Major Solar (UMS), a Platform App Builder built an HR Onboarding application that includes custom objects, page layouts, Lightning record pages, and an Apex class. The application is built in a Developer sandbox tied to UMS's production org. UMS's wholly-owned subsidiary, UMS Logistics, runs a separate Salesforce production org that has no deployment connection to UMS's production org. The app builder must move the HR Onboarding application from UMS's Developer sandbox to UMS Logistics' production org for evaluation. Which deployment plan should the app builder use?

options.text: Create an unmanaged package in UMS's Developer sandbox and install it in UMS Logistics' production org using the install URL
Create a managed package in UMS's Developer sandbox and install it in UMS Logistics' production org using the install URL
Upload an outbound change set from UMS's Developer sandbox to UMS Logistics' production org
Refresh a UMS Logistics sandbox from UMS's Developer sandbox, then deploy from there using change sets

explanation: Change sets only work between orgs connected to the same production org, so an unmanaged package uploaded from the sandbox and installed via its URL is the way to move metadata to an unrelated org for evaluation. A managed package needs a namespace and is meant for distribution, and sandboxes can't be refreshed across orgs.

text: Universal Containers wants to automatically send an email notification to the account owner immediately after a related opportunity is Closed Won. The Platform App Builder chooses to implement this automation using Flow Builder. Which flow type and configuration must the app builder use to update a related record and trigger an email alert?

options.text: A record-triggered flow configured for Fast Field Updates
An autolaunched flow invoked by a validation rule
A screen flow deployed via an AgentExchange package
A record-triggered flow configured for Actions and Related Records

explanation: The 'Actions and Related Records' optimization (after-save) is required when a record-triggered flow updates related records or calls actions such as Send Email; 'Fast Field Updates' (before-save) can only modify the triggering record. Validation rules can't launch flows.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) currently deflects its customers to a help article when they have questions about shipping including package location, delays, and complaints. CK wants to automate this experience with dynamic, real-time support. What should a Platform App Builder recommend?

options.text: Create an approval flow to route customer shipping questions to a specific approver
Use Agentforce to take actions such as looking up missing packages, verifying shipping delays, and offering discount codes
Set up scheduled email templates to all customers with links to help articles regarding shipping and delays
Embed a screen flow on CK's external site for users to submit details about their problem to create a Case

explanation: Agentforce agents can answer shipping questions conversationally and take actions — look up a package, check for delays, issue a discount code — giving customers dynamic, real-time support instead of a static article. Approvals, scheduled emails, and a case-submission flow don't provide that interactive experience.

text: At Cloud Kicks, a record-triggered flow on the Opportunity object that updates related Contract records has begun failing intermittently in production. The Platform App Builder needs to identify which element is failing and review the input and output values for each affected run without asking users to reproduce the error. How should the app builder do this?

options.text: Review the Flow Interview records in Setup to inspect paused interview variable values
Review the failed flow interviews in the Monitor tab in the Automation App
Use the Apex Replay Debugger against the flow
Open the flow in Flow Builder and run Debug with the "Run flow as another user" option enabled

explanation: The Automation app's Monitor tab lists failed flow interviews with the failing element and the input/output values for each run, so the app builder can diagnose production failures without reproducing them. Paused interviews and debug runs don't show historical failures, and Apex Replay Debugger is for code.

text: A recently refreshed Partial sandbox at Cloud Kicks has no data in the custom object Shipping. Checking in production, there are 2 million rows of data in the object. What is the reason the data is missing?

options.text: The sandbox is still populating data
The object was not selected in the sandbox template
The sandbox was refreshed too early
The Partial sandbox is at capacity

explanation: Partial Copy sandboxes copy data only for objects selected in the sandbox template; if Shipping wasn't included, the object arrives empty regardless of production volume. Capacity or timing wouldn't leave the object completely empty.

text: Ursa Major Solar (UMS) uses Cases to track customer complaints, an Issue__c object to represent known problems with its solar panels, and a Case_Issue__c junction object to relate known problems to customer complaints. Periodically, UMS conducts audits which require the auditing users to view Case_Issue__c records. Which access levels must a Platform App Builder configure to give UMS users access to Case_Issue__c records?

options.text: Read-Only access on Case_Issue__c
Read-Only access on Issue__c and Case_Issue__c
Read-Only access on Case and Issue__c
Read-Only access on Case and Case_Issue__c

explanation: Case_Issue__c is a junction whose records are visible only to users with at least Read access to both master objects, so auditors need Read on Case and on Issue__c (the junction's own permission then follows). Granting access to the junction alone doesn't reveal its records.
reviewNote: Key taken from the simulator file; worth a second look — see explanation.

text: A business user at Universal Containers wants to update an Account directly from an opportunity record. What should the Platform App Builder create so the business user can make these edits?

options.text: Formula fields displaying the Account fields
An update record action with a details component
An update record item with a related record component
Opportunity fields updated by a process

explanation: An Update a Record quick action on Opportunity targeting the Account, combined with a Related Record component on the Opportunity page, lets users edit the parent account's fields inline from the opportunity. Formula fields are read-only, and a process doesn't provide an edit UI.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to broadcast an email to 7,000 contacts in Salesforce on a regular basis, but realizes the Salesforce mass email functionality has a limitation on the number of emails that can be sent each day. Which action should the Platform App Builder take?

options.text: Request Salesforce increase the number of maximum daily emails
Research and evaluate products available on AgentExchange to send mass emails
Export Contacts to a CSV file and use an email client to send the emails
Develop Apex code and a Lightning web component to send daily emails

explanation: Salesforce's daily mass-email limit is a platform constraint that isn't raised on request; for regular broadcasts to thousands of contacts the recommended path is a mass-email product from AppExchange. Exporting to an email client loses tracking, and custom code still hits the same limits.

text: Universal Containers (UC) is integrating Salesforce with an external data warehouse. UC wants to make sure that any user that has the Integration user permission set has Read access to all the fields on the Account object, including any new fields that are created, without updating permissions again in the future. What should the Platform App Builder recommend to achieve the requirements?

options.text: Grant View All Data in System Permissions
Change Account Object Permissions by using View All Records
Create a permission set group
Assign View All Fields in Account Object Permissions

explanation: The View All Fields object permission grants read access to every field on the object, including fields created later, so the integration permission set never needs updating. View All Records and View All Data are record-level permissions, and a permission set group doesn't add future fields.

text: Cloud Kicks wants to display the number of opportunities that are Closed Won with a close date within the last year on the Account detail page. What should a Platform App Builder use to implement this?

options.text: Roll-up summary field
Validation rule
Formula field
Activity timeline

explanation: A roll-up summary field on Account with type COUNT over Opportunities, filtered to Stage = Closed Won and Close Date within the last year, displays the number directly on the account. Formula fields can't aggregate child records.

text: An inventory management system outside of Salesforce publishes a secure messaging notification whenever an item goes out of stock. The Platform App Builder needs to design a process in Salesforce that listens for this specific message payload and instantly creates a task for the procurement team. Which flow type is designed to execute immediately upon receiving this external message structure?

options.text: Record-triggered flow
Autolaunched flow with no trigger
Screen flow
Platform event-triggered flow

explanation: A platform event-triggered flow subscribes to a platform event and runs the moment a message with the defined payload is published — the external system publishes the out-of-stock event and the flow creates the procurement task. Record-triggered, screen, and plain autolaunched flows don't listen for external messages.

text: Universal Containers (UC) wants to build an onboarding process for new customers which will include multi-user interactions with multiple steps across different days. Which automation tool should UC use?

options.text: Entitlement process
Flow Orchestration
Custom Lightning web component
Screen flow

explanation: Flow Orchestration coordinates multi-step, multi-user processes over time — assigning interactive steps to different users across days and tracking the overall stage. A single screen flow is one user's session, entitlements are for support SLAs, and an LWC would require code.

text: Universal Containers has a Private sharing model for Accounts and Opportunities and uses Territory Management to grant access to records. - Sales Rep A manually shares an opportunity record with Sales Rep B. - Sales Rep B has access to the Account even though the Account is not in their territory. - Sales Rep C cannot see either record. Why is Sales Rep B able to see the Account related to the Opportunity?

options.text: Sales Rep B was added to the Account team
Sales Rep B has implicit access to the Account
Sharing set is granting access to the Account
Account was also manually shared

explanation: Users who gain access to a child record (the manually shared opportunity) receive implicit Read access to its parent Account, even under a Private model and outside their territory. Rep C got neither share, so sees nothing; no account team or sharing set is involved.

text: The Platform App Builder at Universal Containers recently launched a project management app to better track expansion projects with ever-changing timelines. The app has provided increased visibility of project status, but the app builder finds that users are back-dating their projects which is preventing stakeholders from having real-time insight on integral timeline updates. How should the app builder solve for this?

options.text: Implement field tracking on all key date fields to review with stakeholders
Prevent users from editing date fields once the record has been created
Auto-populate key dates using formula fields based on project start date based on average project timelines
Use a validation rule to prevent users from entering dates that are in the past

explanation: A validation rule that rejects dates earlier than TODAY() stops users from back-dating project timelines while still allowing legitimate future changes. Field history only reveals the problem afterwards, locking dates blocks real updates, and formulas can't be edited by users.

text: Universal Containers (UC) tracks Account locations in Zip Code, a custom text field with a validation rule to enforce proper formatting of the U.S. ZIP+4 code for UC's orders. Which formula should the Platform App Builder create on Order to display only the first five digits of Zip Code from the parent Account?

options.text: LPAD(Account.Zip_Code__r, 5)
TEXT(Account.Zip_Code__c, 5)
LEFT(Account.Zip_Code__c, 5)
BEGINS(Account.Zip_Code__r, 5)

explanation: LEFT(Account.Zip_Code__c, 5) returns the first five characters of the parent Account's ZIP+4 value through the Order's Account lookup. LPAD pads, BEGINS returns a boolean, and TEXT doesn't take a length argument.

text: At Cloud Kicks, a Platform App Builder is ready to deploy a release from a Full sandbox to production. The deployment runs the full Apex test suite, which takes about 30 minutes. The team has scheduled a Saturday morning cutover window and wants to minimize the time the deployment occupies during the window. Which deployment plan should the app builder use?

options.text: Upload the outbound change set at the start of the cutover window and click Deploy
Upload the outbound change set during the cutover window and select Run Local Tests to reduce the deployment time
Upload the outbound change set, run Validate Only against production a day before the cutover, then click Quick Deploy at the start of the cutover window
Upload the outbound change set the day before the cutover, then click Deploy at the start of the cutover window

explanation: Run the change set with Validate Only against production ahead of time; a successful validation (with tests passed) enables Quick Deploy for up to 10 days, so the actual deployment during the cutover window skips the 30-minute test run. Deploying normally at cutover reruns all tests.

text: Ursa Major Solar's sales team has been struggling to enter data on mobile since rollout; the team dislikes scrolling through all of the fields to input only the necessary data. How should the Platform App Builder solve this with minimal impact to desktop users?

options.text: Reorder the fields to make sense for the reps when in the field
Deselect the phone radio button on the Lightning record page assignment
Filter components by device using Form Factor
Update the training documentation with better screenshots

explanation: Component visibility filters can use Form Factor, so field sections or components can be shown only on desktop or only on phone, giving mobile users a streamlined page while desktop users keep the full layout. Reordering or removing the phone assignment doesn't reduce fields, and documentation doesn't fix the UX.

text: Universal Containers has a new custom object for Invoices that includes an Invoice Number field. Before the Invoice object can be used, invoices will be migrated from an external system maintaining their current Invoice Number. After the migration, each new Invoice created in Salesforce must have a unique Invoice Number. How should the Platform App Builder configure the Invoice Number field?

options.text: Create an AutoNumber field and migrate the Invoices in Invoice Number order
Create a Text field and mark it as a unique external ID field
Create a Text field for the original Invoice Number and an AutoNumber field for the Salesforce Invoice Number
Create a Text field, then change it to AutoNumber after the migration

explanation: A Text field marked Unique and External ID accepts the migrated invoice numbers as-is, rejects duplicates for new invoices, and supports upserts during migration. Auto-number fields can't hold externally assigned values and can't be converted from text after data exists.

text: At Universal Containers, a Platform App Builder has built a record-triggered flow on Opportunity that updates several related records when the stage changes to Closed Won. The flow must also block the save and show the user an inline error message on the Stage field when the related Account does not have a Contract record. The error must surface in the Lightning UI exactly as a validation rule error would. Which Flow Builder element should the app builder add to the flow?

options.text: Screen element that displays the error message before the save completes
Fault path leading to an Assignment element that sets an error message variable
Custom Error element with a configured error message and field-level placement on Stage
End element placed on the path where no Contract record is found so the flow stops processing

explanation: The Custom Error element in a record-triggered flow blocks the save and displays a message either at the top of the record or on a specific field, exactly like a validation rule error. Screens can't appear in record-triggered flows, and fault paths or End elements don't stop the save.

text: Cloud Kicks streams loyalty data from an external system into Data 360 as a data model object (DMO). When a loyalty member's tier in that DMO changes to Diamond, the company wants Salesforce automation to run automatically in near real time. The trigger is a change to the DMO in Data 360, not a change to a Salesforce record. Which type of flow should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: Template-triggered prompt flow
Schedule-triggered flow
Data 360-triggered flow
Record-triggered flow

explanation: A Data 360 (Data Cloud)-triggered flow runs when data in a data model object changes, so a tier change on the loyalty DMO can start Salesforce automation in near real time. Record-triggered flows fire only on Salesforce records, and schedule- or template-triggered flows don't react to DMO changes.

text: Northern Trail Outfitters wants the field sales team to only see the accounts that they own. Separate North American and European marketing teams should only see accounts in their respective regions. The inside sales team needs to see all accounts in Salesforce. How should the Platform App Builder accomplish this?

options.text: Set the organization-wide default to Private for accounts. Create criteria-based sharing rules for each marketing team, and create an Inside Sales Team profile with the "View All" setting for accounts
Set the organization-wide default to Public for accounts. Create profiles for each marketing team, and create an Inside Sales Team role that is at the top of the role hierarchy
Set the organization-wide default to Private for accounts. Create permission sets for each marketing team, and create an Inside Sales Team profile with the "View All" setting for accounts

Set the organization-wide default to Public for accounts. Create criteria-based sharing rules for each marketing team, and create an Inside Sales Team permission set with the "View All" setting for accounts

explanation: With Account OWD set to Private, field reps see only what they own, criteria-based sharing rules on region open North American and European accounts to the right marketing teams, and the inside sales profile gets View All on Accounts to see everything. Public OWD would expose all accounts to the field team.

text: At Universal Containers, each admin and developer uses a separate Developer Pro sandbox. Configuration and code are migrated to a partial data sandbox for combination and initial testing. Once approved, the configuration and code are then migrated to a full copy sandbox for final load and regression testing before going to production. When should the full copy sandbox be refreshed?

options.text: After a new user is added to production
After each push from the partial data sandbox
After each major release to production
After User Acceptance Testing (UAT) is complete

explanation: The Full Copy sandbox is the final regression and load-test environment, so it should be refreshed after each major production release to reflect the new production baseline. Refreshing after every partial-sandbox push or UAT would discard in-progress testing.

text: Universal Containers wants to deploy AI-powered autonomous agents that can take actions on behalf of users, using natural language instructions and data from Salesforce. Which feature should the Platform App Builder configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: Omni-Channel Routing
Einstein Prediction Builder
Agentforce
Flow Orchestration

explanation: Agentforce is the platform for building autonomous AI agents that use natural-language instructions (topics and actions) and Salesforce data to take actions on behalf of users. Prediction Builder makes predictions, Orchestration coordinates human steps, and Omni-Channel routes work.

text: When an Opportunity stage is changed to Closed Lost, users need to complete the Reason Lost field. How should a Platform App Builder configure this requirement?

options.text: Use the page layout editor to require the Reason Lost field
Make the Reason Lost field required using Dynamic Forms without filter criteria
Use field-level requirement to require users complete "Reason Lost"
Create a validation rule to enforce the conditional requirement

explanation: A validation rule that requires Reason_Lost__c when StageName = 'Closed Lost' enforces the field only in that situation. Page layout and field-level 'required' settings apply universally, and Dynamic Forms can't make a field conditionally required without filter criteria.

text: A Platform App Builder wants to configure a sandbox environment for users to perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of the latest features from developers. The sandbox should include about 500 MB worth of data configured via a template. Also, the sandbox should be refreshed weekly. Which sandbox meets the requirements?

options.text: Developer
Full
Partial Copy
Developer Pro

explanation: A Partial Copy sandbox uses a template, holds up to 5 GB of sample data (well over 500 MB), and can be refreshed every 5 days, which fits a weekly UAT cycle with data. Developer Pro has no production data, and Full sandboxes refresh only every 29 days.

text: At Universal Containers, the finance team requires every Expense_Report__c record to be approved first by the employee's manager and then, if the total amount is greater than $5,000, by the chief financial officer (CFO). The team wants a single declarative process that routes the request to each approver in sequence, tracks each response, and updates the Expense Report's Status field after the final approval. Which Salesforce feature should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A record-triggered flow with a Decision element that routes to different paths based on the Expense Report's amount
A validation rule on Expense_Report__c that blocks the save until a custom Approved_By__c field is populated
A flow approval process with sequential approval steps for the manager and the CFO
A screen flow that prompts the manager and the CFO to enter their decision when launched from the Expense Report record page

explanation: Flow approval processes (approvals built in Flow Builder) support sequential approval steps — manager first, then CFO when the amount exceeds $5,000 — while tracking each response and updating the record on final approval, all in one declarative process. A Decision-based flow or screen flow doesn't provide approval tracking, and a validation rule can't route requests.

text: A Platform App Builder needs to create a flow that can be invoked by a custom Lightning web component. To do this, the app builder wants to create a variable that can accept an input parameter, so that values can be passed from the component into the flow. How should the app builder create this variable?

options.text: Use a global variable like $Record
Inputs can be passed through the 'Constant' resource type in flow
Define public properties in the component that can be referenced by the flow
Create a Variable resource type in flow with 'Available for Input' checked

explanation: Mark a flow Variable resource as 'Available for input' so the Lightning web component can pass a value into it when it launches the flow. Constants can't receive input, $Record isn't available in this context, and component properties alone don't create the flow-side input.

text: Universal Containers wants users to have access to the pricing guidelines document when viewing a contract related to an Account. Which feature should a Platform App Builder use to create easy access to the document?

options.text: A custom detail page link on the Contract object
Quick action on the Contracts object
A custom detail page link on the Account object
Quick action on the Account object

explanation: A custom link on the Contract object's detail page opens the pricing guidelines document right where users are viewing the contract. Placing it on Account is one step removed, and quick actions are for creating or updating records rather than opening documents.

text: A Platform App Builder would like to simplify the user experience with customized, intuitive record pages that change based on field input. What should they consider?

options.text: Create multiple Page Layouts dependent on the User
Save a Filtered Related List for users to update records
Leverage Screen Flows for user input
Migrate to Dynamic Forms and create visibility rules

explanation: Dynamic Forms with component visibility rules shows or hides field sections and components based on field values, so the record page adapts as users enter data. Multiple layouts, filtered related lists, and screen flows don't make the record page itself responsive to input.

text: A Platform App Builder is troubleshooting user visibility issues and needs to identify why a user is unable to experience record page Field Sections on their mobile device. Which action should they take?

options.text: Migrate back to standard Page Layouts for mobile users while maintaining Dynamic Forms for desktop users
Add additional Field Section components to simplify the Mobile layout
Enable Dynamic Forms and Dynamic Highlights on Mobile in Salesforce Mobile App Studio
Use visibility rules to optimize for Mobile use

explanation: Dynamic Forms field sections appear in the Salesforce mobile app only when Dynamic Forms on Mobile is turned on in the mobile app settings; without it, mobile users see the standard page layout. Adding sections or visibility rules won't help until the feature is enabled.
reviewNote: Key taken from the simulator file; worth a second look — see explanation.

text: Universal Containers has configured a record-triggered flow that fails with an error stating that the maximum number of SOQL queries has been exceeded. While reviewing the interview path in the Flow Debugger, the Platform App Builder notices that the exact same Get Records element is being executed repeatedly for every record in the transaction. How should the app builder change the flow to fix this error?

options.text: Change the flow trigger from After-Save to Before-Save
Move the Get Records element outside of the Loop element
Connect a Fault Path to a custom Screen element
Change the Loop element to an Assignment element

explanation: A Get Records element inside a loop issues one SOQL query per iteration, which is what exhausts the query limit. Retrieve the records once before the loop (or restructure the query) and reference the collection inside it.

text: Due to the complexity of the Universal Containers sandbox release schedule and requirements, its deployment process requires that change sets are used to migrate from one environment to another. Which item is a Platform App Builder able to move when using a change set?

options.text: Custom objects
Standard fields
Lightning page assignments
Users

explanation: Custom objects (with their fields, layouts, and related metadata) are deployable components in change sets. Standard fields exist in every org and aren't deployed, Lightning page assignments aren't a change set component, and users are data.

text: Universal Containers (UC) is building a screen flow to enhance the user experience for creating new opportunity records and related opportunity products. UC needs to configure a requirement so if the opportunity product creation fails, both opportunity and opportunity product creation should be rolled back. The current configuration is: Screen Flow Start → Opportunity Screen → Create Opportunity → Opportunity Product Screen → Create Opportunity Product → End. What is the required change the Platform App Builder must make in order to achieve the requirements?

options.text: Add Fault Path to Create Opportunity Product and Roll Back Records
Move Create Opportunity after Opportunity Product Screen, then add Fault Path to Create Opportunity Product and Roll Back Records
Move Create Opportunity before Opportunity Screen, then add Fault Path to Create Opportunity and Roll Back Records
Add Delete Records after Create Opportunity Products

explanation: To roll both creations back together, create the Opportunity only after both screens have collected input, then add a fault path from Create Opportunity Product to a Roll Back Records element so a failure undoes the opportunity created in the same transaction. Screens commit the transaction, so the opportunity must not be created before the second screen.

text: A service manager provides a Platform App Builder with color code requirements for case age on open cases. - New cases populate a green circle. - Day-old cases populate a yellow circle. - Three day-old cases populate a red circle. What should the app builder use to implement these requirements?

options.text: Custom button
Lightning web component
Formula field
Quick action

explanation: A formula field can calculate case age from CreatedDate and return IMAGE() of a green, yellow, or red circle based on the thresholds — no code required. Buttons and quick actions don't display status, and an LWC is unnecessary.

text: A Platform App Builder wants to create a formula field on an Account to include data from related Contacts, but is unable to find the relationship in the formula editor. What is a limitation of formulas that is likely causing the issue?

options.text: The Contact and Account objects do not have a master-detail relationship
The formula field limit was reached on the Account object
They are unable to reference the child records
There are more than 5,000 characters in the formula

explanation: Formula fields can traverse relationships upward to parent records but can't reference child records (such as an Account's Contacts). Aggregating or reading child data requires a roll-up summary (master-detail) or automation.

text: At Ursa Major Solar, only users with the Outer Planets profile need to see the Jupiter field on the Solar System object. What should the Platform App Builder use to satisfy this requirement?

options.text: Filtered view
Classic encryption
Field-level security
Sharing rules

explanation: Field-level security controls which profiles and permission sets can see a field; making the Jupiter field visible only to the Outer Planets profile meets the requirement. Sharing rules control records, and filtered views and encryption don't restrict field visibility per profile.

text: Cloud Kicks (CK) tracks the support level of its customers on the Account record page. CK wants to show a text notification on a Case record page when the related account is a platinum-level customer. How should a Platform App Builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Add a rich text component to the Case Lightning page. Set the component visibility of the rich text component to show when the account support level is platinum.
Create a text-only custom Lightning web component. Clone the Case page layout. Drag the custom Lightning web component into the page, and assign the layout to platinum cases.
Create a text-only custom Lightning web component. Drag the custom Lightning web component into the Case page layout. Set its visibility to show when the account support level is platinum.
Clone the Case Lightning page. Add a rich text component to the new page, and assign this page to platinum accounts.

explanation: Add a Rich Text component to the Case Lightning record page with the notification text and set its component visibility to show when the related Account's support level equals Platinum. No custom component or duplicate page is needed.

text: A new field has been added to the Applicant object that is part of an unmanaged package. A recruiter runs the Position with or without Applicants report and notices that the new field is missing as an option to add as a column. How should a Platform App Builder troubleshoot this issue?

options.text: Check Allow Reports for the Position and Applicant objects
Add the field to the custom report type field layout
Update the profile with the Manage Public Reports permission
Adjust the field-level security to include in the report type

explanation: Fields added after a custom report type was created aren't automatically available in reports built on it; edit the report type's field layout and add the new field. Object report settings, permissions, and FLS aren't the cause when the field is simply absent from the type.

text: A Platform App Builder is running a report on Accounts with Opportunities. The default record count (or RowCount) value is included. Which value is this default record count based on?

options.text: The total count of all parent object records
The total count of all object records, including both parent and child records
The total count of all object records related to Opportunities
The total count of all child object records

explanation: Exam key: the default record count in an 'Accounts with Opportunities' report is based on the parent (Account) records. Note: in practice the row count reflects the rows returned by the report — one per Account–Opportunity pair — so treat this as the simulator author's interpretation.
reviewNote: Key taken from the simulator file; worth a second look — see explanation.

text: Ursa Major Solar has made a great app that leadership wants to share with the world for free via AgentExchange. What should a Platform App Builder consider about the type of package when uploading to AgentExchange?

options.text: Managed packages provide intellectual property protection on Apex code
Managed packages need a per-user charge on AgentExchange
Unmanaged packages allow for patches on programmatic changes but not Apex
Unmanaged packages can be set up to prevent user customizations

explanation: Managed packages hide and protect the Apex code and other intellectual property and support upgrades, which matters when publishing to AgentExchange even for free. They don't require a per-user charge, and unmanaged packages expose all code and allow full customization.

text: Universal Containers created a custom object called Component to capture details about products sold. Which approach should a Platform App Builder take to show Component as a related list on Product?

options.text: Create a junction object to relate Component and Product. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout
Create a lookup relationship on Component to Product. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout
Create a master-detail relationship on Product to Component. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout
Create a roll-up on Product. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout

explanation: A lookup relationship field on Component pointing to Product makes Component a child of Product, so the Component related list can be added to the Product page layout. Relationship fields go on the child object, and a junction or roll-up isn't needed.

text: Universal Containers' Human Resources application requires that when a new Employee record is created, a welcome task must be generated immediately. Additionally, if the onboarding status is still "Pending" 5 days before the start date, a reminder email must be sent. How should the Platform App Builder configure a single record-triggered flow to handle both timelines?

options.text: Build a schedule-triggered flow that runs every 5 days
Add a Scheduled Path alongside the Run Immediately path
Configure a Pause element within a screen flow
Place an Asynchronous Path inside a Loop element

explanation: A record-triggered flow can have both an immediate path (create the welcome task on creation) and a Scheduled Path set relative to a date field (5 days before Start Date) with a condition on onboarding status — both timelines in one flow. Pause elements belong to autolaunched/screen flows, and async paths don't schedule.

text: The developer at Universal Containers wants to test code in a sandbox environment. To ensure the code works properly, the sandbox needs to have at least half a gigabyte of data. The sandbox will need to be refreshed after each 3-day sprint. Which type of sandbox should the Platform App Builder provision to the developer?

options.text: Developer Pro
Full Copy
Developer
Partial Data

explanation: A Developer Pro sandbox holds up to 1 GB of data and can be refreshed daily, so it accommodates half a gigabyte of test data and a refresh after every 3-day sprint. Developer sandboxes cap at 200 MB, and Partial or Full sandboxes have longer refresh intervals.

text: The VP of sales at Universal Containers has asked the Platform App Builder to let sales reps create opportunity records directly from the account, with a number of fields pre-populated. Which feature should the app builder use to give users the ability to create the opportunity?

options.text: Custom button
Default action
Custom link
Quick action

explanation: A Create a Record quick action on Account that creates an Opportunity lets you predefine field values from the account and present the rest to the rep, launched from the account's action bar. Custom buttons and links can't set predefined values on the create form.

text: The Platform App Builder at AW Computing needs to capture information about sales rep help requests for sales engineering. Some opportunities are more complex and require many different requests for help. Additionally, the date of the most recent request should be displayed on the Opportunity page. What should the app builder use to accomplish this?

options.text: Custom object with master-detail field to Opportunity
Opportunity with lookup field to custom object
Custom object with lookup field to Opportunity
Opportunity with master-detail field to custom object

explanation: A custom Help Request object with a master-detail to Opportunity supports many requests per opportunity and lets a roll-up summary field (MAX of request date) show the most recent request on the Opportunity page. A lookup wouldn't allow the roll-up, and the relationship field lives on the child.

text: A Platform App Builder has created a custom object that should be included in the Global Search results. Which step should the app builder take to ensure the results are generated in the Global Search?

options.text: Create a custom tab set to Default Off
Create a search layout
Create a custom tab set to Hidden
Create a search filter

explanation: A custom object is searchable in Global Search once it has a custom tab — even one set to Default Off — because the tab makes the object available to search. Search layouts control result columns, and a hidden tab or search filter doesn't enable search.
